segmente.text: Psychology says if you want more sales, you should say the negative first.
For example, notice the difference when I say,
our product is the best in the world, but it's really expensive,
versus when I say, our product is really expensive, but it is the best in the world.
You'll get your money back if you don't see the results you want.
Or, if you don't see the results you want, you'll get your money back.
Start with the negative and end with the positive,
because people remember the last thing you say most.
